def _lab_drift(train, x, complete, taus, theta, maps, dt, time, sy):

    basis = np.column_stack((np.ones(len(x)), x[:, 1:] @ theta[3:7]))
    correction = np.zeros((4, 2))
    for lab in range(4):

            residual = y - a @ coef
            weight = 1 / np.sqrt(1 + (residual / (2.5 * _mad(residual)))**2)
        correction[lab] = coef
    return correction
